LESSON: SAFE TRAVEL

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Safe Travel

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Safe Travel. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use basic road safety signs appropriately to enable safe travel
2. appreciate the use of basic road safety signs in enabling safe travel. neighborhood and report back.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. use basic road safety signs appropriately to enable safe travel
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use basic road safety signs appropriately to enable safe travel. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate the use of basic road safety signs in enabling safe travel. neighborhood and report back.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the use of basic road safety signs in enabling safe travel. neighborhood and report back. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Safe Travel.
2. Explain Safe Travel to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Safe Travel. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Safe Travel important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
